legend.tcm: Standard TCM materia dietetica food-nature classifications (Bensky/Flaws tradition; five natures: cold, cool, neutral, warm, hot)
legend.ayurveda: Classical Ayurvedic virya (potency) per Charaka / Sushruta / Bhavaprakasha tradition (cooling = shita, heating = ushna)
legend.unani: Unani mizaj/taseer per the Ibn Sina (Qanun) tradition and everyday hakimi/desi usage (hot/cold, optionally dry/moist)
legend.histamine: SIGHI histamine compatibility list (Swiss Interest Group Histamine Elimination Diet); 0 = well tolerated, 3 = very poorly tolerated; markers: liberator (L), high-histamine (H), other biogenic amines (A), DAO blocker (B)
legend.nutrition: USDA FoodData Central per 100 g (per 100 ml for drinks); dishes are Claude estimates for a typical preparation, marked with "estimate": true

confidence.high: Consistently documented across standard references of that tradition
confidence.moderate: Documented but with some variation between references
confidence.contested: References genuinely disagree, or classical documentation is thin — treat as indicative, flag visibly in UI
